en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a partially destroyed wooden bridge over a river with fast-moving water, likely due to a flood. Debris is visible under and beyond the broken section of the bridge, and there's a large building (possibly a church) in the background. The reverse side has handwritten notes in Swedish and printed information indicating it was produced by Jonas Theodor Höglund, Sundsvall, in 1919.
